evidence.C1: Pleasant coherent pond with varied koi patterns (kohaku, sanke) and lighting changes (lantern glow, fireflies), though the vector style lacks the 'convincing form' or deep water refraction for a perfect 10.
evidence.C2: The 'calm full-screen mode' (Screenshot 6) successfully removes all UI for a dominating scene, though the default view has slightly busy instructional text.
evidence.C3: Exceeds criteria with 'drag to lead', 'tap a koi for its name card', and a rich soundscape including sleep timer, mood auto-follow, and positional audio.
evidence.C4: Layout is tidy on both sizes and the mixer sheet is well grouped, but the mobile instruction tooltip text is visibly truncated ('... T...').

fixes: Fix the truncated instruction tooltip on the 390px mobile view which cuts off at '... T...' instead of showing the full text.
Improve the 'Hide controls' UX: currently the button hides the bar containing itself, forcing reliance on the 'Esc' key or the Full Screen eye button to restore it; consider tap-to-reveal.
Enhance the visual integration of the koi with the water (e.g., stronger shadows or refraction) to increase perceived depth and push the art quality from 'pleasant' to 'immersive'.

evidence.C1: Koi are recognisable with varied patterns (kohaku, ogon, asagi visible) and the scene has caustic light, shadows, and time-of-day shifts, but the fish read as flat illustrated shapes rather than convincing forms; stones are simple gray ovals, lily pads are flat green discs, and there is little sense of water depth.
evidence.C2: Scene dominates the viewport and the bottom control bar is quiet, with a 'Hide controls' option and a finished-looking full-screen calm mode (eye button), but the top nav (Tank/Fishing/Garden/Journal/Focus/Pond) and the 'Riak' header with Level/coin chips stay visible and compete with the pond.
evidence.C3: Multiple gentle interactions (tap ripple, hold feed, drag lead, tap koi name card, tap leaf to spin) plus a rich soundscape with volume, layer toggles, mood, koi count 5/9/13, sleep timer 10/20/30 min, positional panning, and keyboard shortcuts (Space/F/R/M/H/Esc).
evidence.C4: Sounds sheet is well-grouped (Volume/Layers/Mood/Koi count/Sleep timer) and controls collapse to icons on 390 px, but the hint pill truncates to 'Tap the water · Hold to feed · Drag to lead · T...' on phone and the persistent top nav eats vertical space on the small viewport.

fixes: Give the koi more dimensional form (subtle gradient/shading along the body, clearer fin separation, better tail taper) so they stop reading as flat shapes and earn the 'leave open on a second screen' feel.
Auto-hide or shrink the top app nav and 'Riak / Level / coins' header when the pond tab is active (or in calm mode) so the scene truly dominates and the calm feel reaches a 9-10.
Fix the truncated interaction hint on 390 px (wrap to two lines, shorten copy, or move it to a discoverable tooltip) so phone users actually see all four gestures.

evidence.C1: Pleasant, coherent pond: varied koi patterns (kohaku, ogon, asagi, chagoi visible), 'caustic light, ripples', koi shadows, and light clearly changes with mood ('lantern glow, moon reflection, fireflies' at night). Falls short of 10: water reads as fairly uniform teal with little depth gradient, and several koi (yellow ogon curves) look like flat bent shapes rather than full-bodied fish.
evidence.C2: Scene is calm and controls are tidy pills, and the dusk full-screen shot is serene with 'all UI hidden'. But the hint pill 'Tap the water · Hold to feed · Drag to lead…' persists in all three desktop shots, and the bottom cluster is two rows tall (5 buttons + 'Hide controls'), so UI never fully gets out of the way.
evidence.C3: Matches the 10 anchor's checklist: 'tap water for a ripple… hold to feed, drag to lead, tap a koi for its name card', leaf spin, keys, plus 'volume, layer toggles, mood, koi count 5/9/13, sleep timer… fades out and dims the pond' with positional panning. Kept from 10: soundscape adjustability is master volume plus 4 on/off layers — no per-layer volume or intensity.
evidence.C4: Tidy at 1440 (centered control bar, aligned header/nav) and at 390 (icon row fits, no overflow); mixer sheet is 'clear and well grouped' (Volume / Layers / Mood / Koi / Sleep timer). Defect: hint pill truncates at 390 ('Drag to lead · T…') and phone controls are icon-only with no labels.

fixes: Make the scene dominate for C2: auto-dismiss the hint pill after the first interaction or a few seconds, and fade the bottom control bar (and 'Hide controls' second row) when idle so calm mode is the default state, not a toggle.

Push C1 toward the second-screen anchor: add water depth (darker centre/edge vignette or layered depth tint under the caustics) and give koi fuller bodies with stronger shading so they read as fish rather than flat curved cut-outs.
Fix 390px polish for C4: stop the hint pill truncating mid-sentence ('Drag to lead · T…') by shortening, wrapping or cycling the tips, and add tooltips/aria-labels to the icon-only phone control row.
